precedents.name: FunSearch
precedents.observed_capability: new finite constructions through short programs and a fast scoring function
precedents.selection_implication: prefer compact candidates, dense feedback and a deterministic final checker
precedents.caveat: record improvement is not the same as settling the surrounding conjecture

precedents.name: AlphaEvolve
precedents.observed_capability: algorithmic search improved some matrix, geometry and combinatorial records
precedents.selection_implication: construction and optimization tasks with executable evaluators are the strongest current default
precedents.caveat: evaluators can be exploited; numeric candidates need exact or interval certification

precedents.name: AlphaProof Nexus open-problem sweep
precedents.observed_capability: reported proofs for 9 of 353 formalized Erdős problems and 44 of 492 OEIS statements
precedents.selection_implication: Lean proof search works best on decomposable statements supported by mature libraries
precedents.caveat: the study found mistranslations and drafts that merely moved the hard step into an unproved lemma

precedents.name: OEIS Open Problems
precedents.observed_capability: low-cost generic agents reportedly resolved 147 of 492 autoformalized conjectures
precedents.selection_implication: large formal pools are useful for screening and proof closure
precedents.caveat: importance is uneven, references are often sparse, and formalization fidelity must be audited

precedents.name: Disproof of an Erdős unit-distance conjecture
precedents.observed_capability: a natural-language research agent proposed a high-value construction and proof that external mathematicians checked
precedents.selection_implication: reserve a minority track for precise, high-value non-formal problems with expert review
precedents.caveat: human verification and exposition remained essential, and the broader asymptotic problem was not closed

precedents.name: Aletheia Erdős sweep
precedents.observed_capability: bulk generation produced many superficially plausible answers
precedents.selection_implication: status, intended meaning and novelty review are more important than raw solve counts
precedents.caveat: of 200 adjudicated candidates reported in the paper, only 13 addressed the intended problem, and some were already known

precedents.name: Formal determination of BB(5)
precedents.observed_capability: a massive search was decomposed into machine-level certificates checked in Coq
precedents.selection_implication: large questions become agent-suitable when split into independently certifiable classes
precedents.caveat: certificate engineering and trusted-computing-base review are substantial research work
